card.name: The word in after Safety and effectiveness
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after "Safety and effectiveness", in the Pediatric Use section of a drug label. It comes just before "pediatric patients".

modes.label: In after safety and effectiveness
modes.description: The linking word "in" that follows "Safety and effectiveness" and leads into pediatric patients.
modes.example: Pediatric Use Safety and effectiveness<< in>> pediatric patients have not been established.

card.plain: It marks the little word "in" in the standard phrase "Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients" on drug labels.
